existingFixParts.component: Expansion tank pressure cap (1.4 bar)

existingFixParts.note: The primary repair part. 06M121013G is Audi's REVISED 6-bolt-pulley pump that replaces the failure-prone early 4-bolt unit (early pumps 06M121013C/D used the 4-bolt pulley). existingFixParts.note: MANDATORY with the revised 6-bolt pump 06M121013G - the updated pump uses a 6-bolt pulley pattern, the old defective pump a 4-bolt. Must be installed together as the cooling-system update. Genuine VW/Audi only.
existingFixParts.component: Water pump pulley - 6-bolt (revised)

existingFixParts.component: Coolant thermostat (combined service with pump)
